question: Ganga Dussehra takes place every year on the _________ day of Shukla Paksha of Jyeshtha month.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ganga Dussehra is celebrated on the **10th **day (Dashami) of the Shukla Paksha (waxing phase of the moon) in the Hindu calendar month of Jyeshtha, which usually falls in May or June according to the Gregorian calendar.
 
• The festival commemorates the day when the Ganges River descended to Earth from heaven. It's a day dedicated to Goddess Ganga and the river's purifying and life-giving power.
 
• People usually celebrate by taking a dip in the Ganges River, which is believed to cleanse them of their sins. It is believed that a dip in the river on this day can bring the devotee to a state of purification and also heal any physical ailments.
 
• Alongside bathing in the river, people also perform aarti (a ritual of light) and make offerings to the river. They also chant hymns and mantras dedicated to Goddess Ganga.
